home.featured_subtitle: A selection of products and cases showcasing my design and building process.
home.about_text: I'm a UX Designer and Researcher with experience in digital products. I work across research, design, and facilitation, always focused on understanding problems and creating viable solutions. Today, I also build my own products using Figma + Claude Code.

about.label: WHO I AM
about.title: Behind the screens
about.subtitle: The side that doesn't fit in a case study.
about.bio_1: I started wanting to understand why things work — or don't. That led me to UX. Today I design, research, and build. Not necessarily in that order.
about.bio_2: I like systems that make sense and processes nobody needs explained twice. My job is making the complex simple — and sometimes the simple, beautiful.
about.off_the_clock: Games, huge One Piece fan, 3 cats and a dog
about.current_obsession: AI as a building tool, not a replacement

process.title: My Process
process.subtitle: From research to deploy — how I work.
process.step1_desc: Understand the real problem: interviews, data, benchmarks. Every decision starts with evidence.
process.step2_desc: Define scope, priorities, and metrics. Align expectations before designing.
process.step3_desc: Wireframes, prototypes, testing. Fast iteration focused on the user.
process.step4_desc: Testing with real users, metric analysis, data-driven adjustments.
process.step5_desc: I implement with Next.js + Tailwind using Claude Code. From Figma to running code.

services.title: Services
services.label: WHAT I DO
services.uxui_desc: Turning ambiguous problems into clear, structured interfaces. I work across the full product lifecycle, from early discovery to polished interactions, always optimizing for the people who'll actually use the thing.
services.uxui_tags: End-to-end product design, Complex workflows, Cross-platform, Interaction design, Prototyping, User flows
services.research_desc: Decisions backed by evidence, not gut feelings. I synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into structures teams can actually act on.
services.research_tags: User research, Synthesis, Information architecture, Product strategy, Data-informed decisions, Stakeholder alignment
services.ds_desc: Building the infrastructure that makes good design repeatable. Component libraries, token architectures, governance models, the boring-sounding stuff that quietly saves thousands of hours.
services.ds_tags: Component architecture, Design tokens, Governance, Contribution models, Team workflows, Documentation
services.ai_desc: Integrating AI where it actually helps, not where it sounds impressive. Pattern recognition, automated QA, intelligent tooling. Humans stay in the loop, decisions stay grounded.
services.ai_tags: AI-assisted tooling, Pattern recognition, Automated QA, Human-AI interaction, Intelligent suggestions, LLM integration
services.d2c_desc: From Figma to code running in production. Rapid prototyping, frontend implementation with Next.js + Tailwind, deploy. No dev team dependency to validate and iterate.
services.d2c_tags: Figma to code, Next.js + Tailwind, Claude Code, Rapid prototyping, Frontend implementation, Deploy
